channel.title: LyricsX
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.description:
What's New

This version adds desktop widgets, an Apple Music-style lyrics window and lyrics translation.

Upgrading

  • This version requires macOS 12 or later.
  • Lyrics searches now leave out bracketed parts of song titles; turn off Strip brackets from search title in Preferences → General to keep them.

New

  • Desktop widgets in four sizes show the current lyrics, on macOS 15 or later.
  • An Apple Music-style lyrics window, with the cover beside animated lyrics, can be turned on in Preferences → Lab on macOS 15 or later.
  • The menu bar shows playback buttons next to the lyrics; turn off Show playback controls in menu bar in Preferences → Lab to hide them.
  • Turn on Hide menu bar lyrics when paused in Preferences → Lab to hide the menu bar lyrics while music is paused.
  • Lyrics translation in Preferences → Lab fills in missing translations using System Translation on macOS 26 or an OpenAI-compatible service.
  • Display language picks which translation is shown.
  • Apple Music can serve as a lyrics source with word-by-word timing once you add your user token in Preferences → Lab.
  • Next Lyrics Candidate switches to the next search result, from the menu or a keyboard shortcut.
  • Preferences → Source offers three ways to rank results: by match score, by source order, or by score with source order breaking ties.
  • Preferences → General can now always search again instead of using saved lyrics, and write your edits back to lyrics files beside the track.
  • The lyrics window has a right-click menu to search for or edit the lyrics.
  • Preferences → Lab can recover original song names through MusicKit and favor lyrics whose cover matches the song.
  • Receive beta updates in Preferences → General lets you try new versions early.

Improvements

  • Lyrics you pick by hand now stay with the song, even when it has embedded lyrics or a lyrics file beside it.
  • Menu bar lyrics use much less CPU on macOS 26 and later.
  • Search results rank instrumental and karaoke versions below the original song.
  • The lyrics window now appears on every Space.
  • Furigana uses the kana supplied by the lyrics source when there is one.

Fixes

  • Wrong Lyrics and Disable Lyrics for Entire Album no longer delete your own lyrics, whether in a file beside the track or in Music.
  • Fixed lyrics coming back after Disable Lyrics for Entire Album.
  • Fixed Search Lyrics applying a different result than the one selected, or applying it to a song that started in the meantime.
  • Skipping a song during a search no longer rewrites the next song's lyrics in Music.
  • Fixed a crash when the lyrics window's font is no longer installed.
  • The menu bar no longer shows the previous song's last line until the next song's lyrics begin.
  • Fixed a crash when dragging text from another app onto the list in Preferences → Source.
  • The Lyrics Offset row in the menu bar menu lines up with the other items again on macOS 27.
  • Lyrics no longer get stuck on the last line when a song repeats.
  • The desktop lyrics highlight is no longer clipped, misaligned or restarted by small position corrections.
  • The last word of a word-timed line now fills in the desktop lyrics and on the Touch Bar.
  • Desktop lyrics no longer cover the Dock on an external display that sits higher or lower than the main display.
  • Lyrics no longer jump back to the first line on pause with some players.
  • With the system Now Playing source, lyrics no longer jump back on pause or run ahead after resuming.
  • Lyrics search no longer misjudges the length of songs playing in Spotify.
  • QQ Music lyrics no longer lose text around parentheses.

Acknowledgements

  • @dongge0210 (#204) added lyrics translation through OpenAI-compatible services.
  • @vizmoe (#179, #181, #182, #184) improved the lyrics window and pausing, and laid the groundwork for AI translation.
  • @SmallSquare (#198) cut the menu bar's CPU use.
  • @garyyeap (#192) fixed the desktop lyrics highlight.
  • @NickJi2019 (#208) fixed desktop lyrics covering the Dock on external displays.
  • @Tosd0 (#148) fixed lyrics getting stuck on the last line.
  • @Mihaly-Ma (#156) made furigana use the source's kana.

item.title: 1.9.0-rc.4
item.description:
What's New

Fixes

  • The Apple Music-style lyrics window no longer jitters when dragged by its top edge.
  • The current line in the Apple Music-style lyrics window no longer flickers while the window is resized.

item.title: 1.9.0-rc.3
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Turn on Hide menu bar lyrics when paused in Preferences → Lab to hide the menu bar lyrics while music is paused.

Improvements

  • The highlight in the Apple Music-style lyrics window now follows each sung syllable, as in Music.
  • The large widget now shows the song's cover.
  • Disable lyrics when: Music is not playing no longer hides the menu bar lyrics.

Fixes

  • The Lyrics Offset row in the menu bar menu lines up with the other items again on macOS 27.

item.title: 1.9.0-rc.2
item.description:
What's New

Upgrading

  • If you added desktop widgets in an earlier beta, remove them and add them again so they all update on time.

Improvements

  • The progress bar in the Apple Music-style lyrics window now looks and works like Music's, growing while you hold it.

Fixes

  • Fixed desktop widgets going black or staying on the previous version after an update until you logged out.
  • The widget no longer shows the last song as playing after you quit the app.
  • Wrong Lyrics and Disable Lyrics for Entire Album no longer erase lyrics you added in Music yourself.
  • Fixed lyrics reappearing after Disable Lyrics for Entire Album, or after Wrong Lyrics while Next Lyrics Candidate was searching.
  • The Apple Music-style lyrics window no longer shows another song's cover after you skip songs quickly.
  • The menu bar no longer shows the previous song's last line until the next song's lyrics begin.
  • The menu bar lyrics now also hide while paused when Disable lyrics when: Music is not playing is on.
  • Fixed a crash when dragging text from another app onto the list in Preferences → Source.

item.title: 1.9.0-rc.1
item.description:
What's New

New

  • New Lyrics translation in Preferences → Lab fills in missing translations, using System Translation on macOS 26 or an OpenAI-compatible service.
  • A Display language setting chooses which translation the desktop lyrics, the Apple Music-style lyrics window and the widget show.
  • Lines in the Apple Music-style lyrics window respond to hovering and clicking as they do in Music.

Improvements

  • Unplayed lines and translations in the Apple Music-style lyrics window now look as they do in Music.
  • The Apple Music-style lyrics window no longer keeps the Mac busy while paused or idle, and its background holds still while paused.
  • Widgets follow the app's settings, including Prefer bilingual lyrics, instead of having options of their own.
  • The large and extra-large widgets show as many whole lyric lines as fit.
  • The widget's playback buttons no longer open the app.
  • Widget lyrics change closer to when each line is sung.

Fixes

  • Lines without word timing now light up all at once in the Apple Music-style lyrics window instead of word by word.
  • Fixed album artwork spilling out of the extra-large widget.
  • Wrong Lyrics no longer deletes lyrics files you keep beside your music.
  • Fixed Search Lyrics applying a different result than the one selected.
  • Lyrics chosen in Search Lyrics or with Next Lyrics Candidate are no longer saved to a song that started playing in the meantime.
  • Fixed rejected lyrics coming back, and lyrics in Music being rewritten, after a search was interrupted.
  • Fixed a crash in the lyrics window when its font is no longer installed.

Acknowledgements

Thanks to @dongge0210 for (#204), which added lyrics translation through OpenAI-compatible services.

item.title: 1.9.0-beta.14
item.description:
What's New

Fixes

  • On macOS 26 and later, the menu bar lyrics no longer keep the CPU busy while the line sits still, and use less of it while scrolling.
  • Songs playing in Spotify now show their cover in the lyrics panel.
  • With Spotify, the lyrics panel no longer shows a nonsense remaining time or a progress bar stuck at the start, and lyrics search no longer misjudges the song's length.

Acknowledgements

Thanks to @SmallSquare for (#198), which tracked down the menu bar's CPU cost and was the basis for its fix.

item.title: 1.9.0-beta.13
item.description:
What's New

Fixes

  • The app and its widget crashed at launch on macOS 26.3 and earlier, caused by a mistake in Apple's SDK that labels a logging API added in macOS 26.4 as available since macOS 11.
  • Clicking the elapsed or remaining time under the lyrics panel's progress bar no longer skips to the previous or next song.

Upgrading

  • If the previous beta does not open on your Mac, download this version from the release page and replace the app by hand, because the broken build cannot update itself.

item.title: 1.9.0-beta.12
item.description:
What's New

New

  • The Apple Music-style lyrics panel has been rebuilt against Music 26 — the backdrop is now built from the cover art itself, line changes cascade one row after another, and type size steps at the same widths Music switches at.
  • Sung words rise syllable by syllable and stay risen, instead of every word swelling and dropping back. Applies to Apple Music lyrics and to the inline-timed results from Kugou, QQ Music and some NetEase sources.
  • The panel hides its title bar in full screen, so there is no black strip across the top any more.
  • A sharper cover in the panel. A higher-resolution copy of the same cover is looked up in the background, and only used once it is confirmed to be the same picture.
  • The lyrics search window shows the score it sorts by, with the cover-similarity bonus spelled out separately.
  • Apple Music lyrics keep their per-word timing, which the parser used to discard.

Fixes

  • A lyric long enough to wrap showed its second line above its first.
  • Saturated cover art could wash the panel's background bright red.
  • Word-timed lyrics lost their bounce on line changes.
  • The karaoke sweep drifted out of alignment with the text during partial repaints.
  • The panel no longer drags the whole system's frame rate down, or sits at 12% CPU with nothing playing.
  • Playback control no longer starts a new process for every play, pause or state check.

Acknowledgements

Thanks to @garyyeap for (#192), the karaoke layout and vertical masking fix.

item.title: 1.9.0-beta.11
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Switch to the next lyrics candidate — results that lose the automatic search are no longer thrown away; every result that clears the search filters now stays in a candidate pool. A new menu item and global shortcut cycle through it, so reaching a rejected candidate no longer means opening the search window and auditioning rows one by one. When the lyrics came from the local cache the pool is empty, so the first press starts a search and switches as soon as a genuinely different candidate arrives, rather than making you wait out a full search. A hand-picked choice is pinned and will not be yanked away by a high-scoring result landing seconds later.
  • Lyrics source ordering modes — the old "enable source priority" checkbox was all-or-nothing: with it on, any result from a higher-listed source beat any result from a lower one and the match score never got a say, so a barely-matching result with half the title right and the duration off by thirty seconds reliably outranked a perfect match from another source. There are now three modes: score only, source first, and a new one where the score leads and the source list only settles scores too close to tell apart. Existing setups migrate to the first two, so nothing reorders on upgrade; the third has to be chosen.
  • A switch to ignore the saved lyrics library — a cache hit short-circuits the entire search, so once a saved file is wrong it stays wrong forever. A new switch on the General page skips that one layer. Embedded lyrics, files sitting beside the track, and anything you picked by hand still come first — those are your files and your decisions, not a cache. A hand-picked choice is recorded inside the lyrics file itself, so it survives a new machine, a restored backup, or a reorganized library. When a search comes back empty the library is read after all, so being offline never drops you from possibly-stale lyrics to none at all.
  • Context menu in the lyrics window — adds Search and Edit. When lyrics are missing, Edit creates a blank lyrics file without overwriting any existing content.
  • The floating lyrics window follows you across Spaces.
  • The settings toolbar now uses system symbols in place of the mix of legacy color icons and hand-drawn images.

Fixes

  • Several defects in the Apple Music-style lyrics panel: the karaoke sweep never painted, leaving the active line at its un-sung translucent white for the whole song; the non-active lines were dimmed on a distance ramp that was never the intended look, sinking the bottom of the panel into the background; per-character time tags made each character rise, hold and drop on its own instead of flowing as one phrase; and the line-change scroll was stepped by hand from the display link, so load on the panel's own main thread flattened the spring into a near-linear slide.
  • Some playback sources briefly report a zero-time state when paused, which sent the desktop and floating lyrics back to the first line.
  • The saving-path pop-up resolved its selection differently on the read and write sides, so lyrics were saved into a directory they were never read back from.
  • User-owned lyrics files sitting next to a track are no longer rewritten unless you explicitly enable it in General settings.
  • The login helper crashed after launching the main app, which made the system treat it as eligible for relaunch and restart it every few seconds — each restart re-opening the already-running app and popping up its settings window.
  • The settings window is now sized from the selected tab's own content, so a tab no longer opens at a different size depending on which tab you came from.
  • Filled in the missing translations for the lyrics window's context menu.

Acknowledgements

Thanks to @vizmoe, whose work ships in this update:

  • (#179) keeping the floating lyrics window visible across Spaces
  • (#181) the fix for lyrics jumping back to the first line on pause
  • (#182) the Search/Edit context menu, and the storage change that keeps lyrics beside a track read-only by default

What's New

Fixes

  • The preferences window no longer keeps popping up every few seconds — When "Launch & Quit with Player" was enabled, the background helper crashed every time it tried to hand control back to the system, so macOS kept relaunching it, and every relaunch reopened the already-running app and pulled up the preferences window. The helper now exits cleanly and skips relaunching the app when it is already running.

item.title: 1.9.0-beta.10
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Apple Music lyrics source — LyricsX can now fetch lyrics from Apple Music. To use it, sign in to Apple Music in your browser, find the `media-user-token` value in the site's cookies, then paste that token into LyricsX preferences.

item.title: 1.9.0-beta.9
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Opt in to prerelease builds — A new *Receive beta updates* switch under *Preferences → Updates* (off by default).
  • Apple Music style lyrics panel now works on macOS 12–14 — Previously required macOS 15. The overall minimum supported macOS is now 12; users on macOS 11 will not receive this or later updates.

Fixes

  • Desktop lyrics no longer flicker about once a second — Affects Apple Music, Spotify and other scriptable players.
  • Karaoke fill and scrubber stay aligned with playback — No longer drift or reset on pause/resume.
  • Pause/resume on the system Now Playing source no longer drifts lyrics — No backward jump on pause; no forward drift on resume.
  • Apple Music style panel reopens at its last size and position — No longer jumps back to the default frame.
  • Apple Music style panel has a minimum window size — Can no longer be shrunk into an unreadable strip.
  • Transport buttons now show hover feedback — Play / previous / next highlight when hovered.
  • Artwork-based lyric matching no longer rejects the correct cover — A too-strict brightness check has been relaxed.

What's New

Fixes

  • Auto-launch with your music player now works again — On some macOS versions the app failed to start automatically when a music player was launched. Fixed.

LyricsX 1.8.6 What's New

Fixes

  • Fixed desktop lyrics flickering — The desktop line-by-line lyrics no longer flicker about once a second during playback (an issue that could also trigger a brief line-change-like animation). Lyrics now track playback smoothly again.

System Requirements

  • Minimum requirement: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)

# LyricsX 1.8.5 What's New
## Fixes
- **Fixed startup crash on macOS 10.15 (Catalina)** — Resolved an issue that caused LyricsX to crash on launch on macOS 10.15.
## System Requirements
- Minimum requirement: **macOS 10.15 (Catalina)**

# LyricsX 1.8.3 What's New
## New Features
- **macOS 10.15 (Catalina) support restored** — LyricsX 1.8.3 once again runs on macOS 10.15. **Note: 1.8.3 is expected to be the final release that supports 10.15; future versions may drop it.** - **NowPlaying support for iOS apps on Mac** — Now-playing detection now correctly identifies iOS apps running on Apple Silicon Macs as a NowPlaying source.
## Fixes
- **Fixed "Launch with Player" no longer triggering** — After upgrading, please toggle the "Launch with Player" preference off and on again to re-arm the helper.
## Other Changes
- **Main app no longer sandboxed** — Upcoming features cannot run inside the App Sandbox, so the main app has dropped the sandbox entitlement. LyricsX is fully open source — you can audit the entire codebase at https://github.com/MxIris-LyricsX-Project/LyricsX.
## System Requirements
- Minimum requirement: **macOS 10.15 (Catalina)**
• Fix NowPlaying whitelist not working.
• Fix NetEase lyrics source (#527). Thanks to @hguandl !

• Add Indonesian, Italian and Dutch support. Thanks to Muhammad Fauzi, cencio1952, Zara Drechsler and everyone participated in the translation!
  • Lyrics filter with regex now works as expected. (#468)
  • Fix a bug where LyricsX failed to read local lyrics with “:” or “/” in the file name.
  • Fix layout issue of karaoke lyrics. (#477)

• New icon.
  • LyricsX is now a universal app.
